title: What debt review really costs #DebtReview
text:
Debt review has a price, and it's more than money. While you're in it, you can't take on new credit, and your credit record shows that you're under debt review until the debts in the plan are paid. The fees are capped: the restructuring fee is your first month's payment, up to R8,000 before VAT, then an after-care fee of up to R450 a month before VAT; legal fees come on top. When the debts in the plan are paid, your debt counsellor issues a clearance certificate (a home loan can still be running), and the credit bureaus must remove the debt review from your record.

Full guide: "Debt Review vs Debt Consolidation vs Debt Counselling: Which One Fits You? (South Africa 2026)" on the Money From Zero channel.

Sources
- National Credit Act 34 of 2005, sections 71 and 88: https://lawlibrary.org.za/akn/za/act/2005/34/eng%402021-06-30/provision/chp_4__part_B__sec_71
